text.p: Mineral explorer and gold miner Australian Gold Fields NL said on Thursday it had upgraded the resource at its Bannockburn gold operation by about 150 percent.
The company said inferred, indicated and measured resources at September 30 comprised 6.72 million tonnes at an average grade of 2.4 grams per tonne containing 527,000 ounces of gold.
This represented an increase of about 315,000 ounces since the company issued its prospectus in March and followed total production of 26,600 ounces in the June and September quarters.

Australian Gold Fields, formerly Southern Goldfields Ltd, said the new discoveries were in an area known as the North West Corridor, 30 metres west of the existing open cut and underground development.
A mining feasibility study and reserve statement were expected to be ready for release with the December quarterly report.
Australian Gold Fields shares were up two cents at 80 cents at 10.10 a.m. (2310 GMT).
